record.paper_title: Ball-Evans approximation problem: recent progress and open problems
record.original_question: Let Ω ⊂ R^n with n ≥ 3, and let f be a homeomorphism in the Sobolev space W^{1,p}(Ω, R^n). The Ball-Evans approximation problem asks whether such a Sobolev homeomorphism can be approximated in the W^{1,p} norm by a sequence of diffeomorphisms or by a sequence of piecewise affine homeomorphisms. Prove or disprove that this approximation is always possible in dimensions n ≥ 3.

evidence.quote: The Ball-Evans approximation problems asks for the approximation of homeomorphism f in the Sobolev space W1,p(Ω, R^n) by a sequence of diffeomorphisms (or piecewise affine homeomorphisms) in the norm of Sobolev space.

Open problem 1. Ball-Evans problem in dimension n ≥ 3: Prove or disprove that W1,p Sobolev homeomorphism in dimension n ≥ 3 can be approximated by a sequence of diffeomorphism (or piecewise affine homeomorphisms).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let n ≥ 3, let Ω ⊂ ℝⁿ be a domain, and let 1 ≤ p < ∞. Suppose f : Ω → ℝⁿ is a homeomorphism onto its image that belongs to the Sobolev space W^{1,p}(Ω, ℝⁿ).

Determine whether the following statement is true: for every such f there exists a sequence (f_k) of either smooth diffeomorphisms or piecewise affine homeomorphisms (each defined on Ω, mapping homeomorphically onto its image) such that
   f_k → f  in the W^{1,p}(Ω, ℝⁿ) norm,
i.e. ||f_k − f||_{L^p(Ω)} + ||Df_k − Df||_{L^p(Ω)} → 0 as k → ∞.

Prove that such an approximation always exists, or exhibit a Sobolev homeomorphism f ∈ W^{1,p}(Ω, ℝⁿ) (for some n ≥ 3 and some p) that admits no such approximating sequence.
artifact.status_search_result: For dimension n = 2 the problem is fully resolved (positively) by Iwaniec–Kovalev–Onninen for 1 < p < ∞ and by Hencl–Pratelli for p = 1. For n ≥ 4 there exist Sobolev homeomorphisms in W^{1,1} (e.g., with Jacobian taking both signs on sets of positive measure) that cannot be approximated by diffeomorphisms or piecewise affine homeomorphisms, giving a negative answer in low regularity. The general problem in n ≥ 3 (especially n = 3 and for higher p) remains widely open.

status_evidence.title: Sobolev Homeomorphism that Cannot be Approximated by Diffeomorphisms in W^{1,1}
status_evidence.snippet: Construction of a Sobolev homeomorphism in dimension n ≥ 4 in W^{1,1} that cannot be approximated by diffeomorphisms or piecewise affine homeomorphisms.
status_evidence.claim: Negative answer is known for n ≥ 4 in W^{1,1}.

status_evidence.title: Diffeomorphic Approximation of Sobolev Homeomorphisms
status_evidence.snippet: Iwaniec–Kovalev–Onninen resolve the planar case for 1 < p < ∞.
status_evidence.claim: Positive answer in the planar case.
